description: Private header for the gPTP (Generalized Precision Time Protocol) stack, defining internal functions, macros, and data structures for managing gPTP ports, intervals, and timestamps within the Zephyr RTOS network subsystem.

methods.name: gptp_is_slave_port
methods.description: Checks if a given port is configured as a slave port.

methods.name: gptp_get_port_number
methods.description: Converts a network interface to its corresponding gPTP port number.

methods.name: gptp_set_time_itv
methods.description: Calculates and stores a log interval in a uscaled nanoseconds structure.

methods.name: gptp_uscaled_ns_to_timer_ms
methods.description: Converts uscaled nanoseconds to milliseconds for timer use.

methods.name: gptp_update_pdelay_req_interval
methods.description: Updates the pDelay request interval and its timer.

methods.name: gptp_update_sync_interval
methods.description: Updates the sync interval and its timer.

methods.name: gptp_update_announce_interval
methods.description: Updates the announce interval and its timer.

methods.name: gptp_timestamp_to_nsec
methods.description: Converts a PTP timestamp to nanoseconds.

methods.name: gptp_change_port_state
methods.description: Changes the port state, with debug variants depending on log level.

methods.name: gptp_change_pa_info_state
methods.description: Changes the port's announce information state, with debug variants depending on log level.
